what_is_it.heading: Izinkinga ze-Prostate ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: I-prostate iyindlala encane ngaphansi kwesinye, ezungezwe ishubhu lomchamo. Ngokwemvelo ikhula ngokukhula. Nge-60, amadoda amaningi ane-prostate yokwandisa. Ukwandiswa okuningi akulungile - kodwa kufanelekile ukubhekwa.
paragraphs: Izinto ezintathu eziyinhloko zingase zingahambi kahle nge-prostate: ingakhula (BPH—benign prostatic hyperplasia), ingavuvuka noma itheleleke (prostatitis), noma ingaba nomdlavuza. Zontathu zibanga izimpawu ezifanayo zomchamo.

Umdlavuza wendlala yesinye umdlavuza ovame kakhulu kwabesilisa baseNingizimu Afrika. Uma ibanjwe kusenesikhathi, iyelapheka kakhulu. Inselelo ukuthi amadoda awakhulumi ngalezi zimpawu futhi awayi ukuyohlolwa. Ukuhlolwa kusukela ku-50 - noma 40 uma uMnyama noma unomlando womndeni - kungenye yezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu indoda engayenza.

items.headline: Okuvame kakhulu
items.body: Umdlavuza wendlala yesinye umdlavuza ovame kakhulu emadodeni aseNingizimu Afrika. Cishe oyedwa kwabayi-8 uzoyithuthukisa ekuphileni kwakhe.

items.headline: Qala ku-50
items.body: Ukuhlolwa kwaminyaka yonke kusukela eminyakeni yobudala engama-50 - noma kusukela ku-40 uma ungumuntu omnyama noma unomlando womndeni womdlavuza wendlala yesinye.

items.headline: Early = belashwa
items.body: Umdlavuza wendlala yesinye isikhathi esingaphezu kwama-95% uphila iminyaka emi-5. Ukubanjwa sekwephuzile, ukusinda kwehla kakhulu. Umehluko wukuhlola.

items.headline: Iningi akuwona umdlavuza
items.body: Izimpawu eziningi zomchamo emadodeni amadala zibangelwa ukukhula kahle, hhayi umdlavuza. Kodwa awukwazi ukusho ngaphandle kokuhlola.

pull_quote.text: Amadoda aseNingizimu Afrika amnyama anengozi ecishe iphindwe kabili kunaleyo yokuphila kwabesilisa abamhlophe, futhi imvamisa abancane banezifo ezinzima kakhulu. Ukuhlolwa kusuka ku-40 - hhayi 50 - kuwucingo olufanele lwamadoda aMnyama.

signs.heading: Okufanele ukubheke
signs.lede: Izimpawu eziningi ze-prostate zivela ekukhulisweni kwe-benign (BPH). Izimpawu ezifanayo zingase zikhombe umdlavuza, ukutheleleka, noma ezinye izimo. Zihlole.

items.title: Ukushintsha komchamo
items.description: Ukugeleza okubuthakathaka, ukuphusha, ukugedla ekugcineni, ukuzwa isinye singenalutho, ukuvuka izikhathi eziningi ebusuku, isidingo esiphuthumayo esiphuthumayo sokuhamba.

items.title: Ubuhlungu noma igazi
items.description: Ukusha lapho uchama (okungenzeka ukuthi ungenwe isifo), igazi emchameni noma esidodeni - kudinga ukuhlolwa okuphuthumayo. Kungaba ukutheleleka, i-BPH, noma umdlavuza.

items.title: Izimpawu eziyisixwayiso sekwephuzile
items.description: Ubuhlungu bethambo (ikakhulukazi emuva noma ezinqulwini), ukuncipha kwesisindo esingaqondakali, ukukhathala, ukuvuvukala kwemilenze - kungase kubonise isifo esithuthukisiwe. Bonana nodokotela ngaphandle kokulibala.

items.myth: Uma ngikwazi ukuchama, i-prostate yami ikahle.
items.fact: Amadoda amaningi anomdlavuza wendlala yesinye anomchamo ojwayelekile ngokuphelele - ikakhulukazi ezigabeni zokuqala lapho ukwelashwa kusebenza kahle kakhulu. Ukuhlola, hhayi izimpawu, kuyayibamba kusenesikhathi.
Ukuhlolwa kuthatha imizuzwana engu-30 futhi akukhululekile, akubuhlungu. Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kwe-PSA kuyinduku yenaliti. Kokubili kungangeza iminyaka engu-15+ empilweni yakho.

Izindlela zokwelapha zesimanje zingcono kakhulu ekulondolozeni umsebenzi kunakudala. Imiphumela engemihle iyahlukahluka ngesiteji kanye nokukhethwa kokwelashwa. Khuluma nodokotela wakho womchamo - hhayi i-inthanethi.

items.myth: Isifo sendoda endala — ngimncane kakhulu ukuthi ngingakhathazeka.
items.fact: Umdlavuza wendlala yesinye ungenzeka kusukela eminyakeni engama-40, ikakhulukazi emadodeni aMnyama noma lawo anomlando womndeni. Umhlahlandlela ojwayelekile wamaqembu anobungozi obukhulu uhlola ukusuka ku-40.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa ingozi futhi uyibambe kusenesikhathi
prevention.lede: Umdlavuza wendlala yesinye awukwazi ukuvinjelwa ngokuphelele, kodwa unganciphisa ingozi futhi uyibambe kusenesikhathi. Indlela yokuphila ibalulekile; ukuhlola kubaluleke kakhulu.

items.title: Ukuhlolwa konyaka kusuka ku-50
items.description: Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kwe-PSA kanye nokuhlolwa kwe-digital rectal. Kumahhala kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni. Unyaka kusukela ku-50 — noma 40 uma Omnyama, umlando womndeni, noma ingozi yofuzo eyaziwayo.

items.title: Ukudla ngendlela yaseMedithera
items.description: Imifino, utamatisi ophekiwe (lycopene), inhlanzi, amafutha omnqumo, okusanhlamvu. Inyama ebomvu encane kanye nobisi. Kuxhunyaniswe nengozi ephansi yomdlavuza wendlala yesinye ocwaningweni.

items.title: Hambisa njalo
items.description: Amadoda akhuthele anamazinga aphansi omdlavuza wendlala yesinye kanye nemiphumela engcono uma bexilongwa. Imizuzu engama-30 yomsebenzi omaphakathi izinsuku eziningi. Ukubalwa kokuhamba.

items.title: Isisindo esinempilo
items.description: Ukukhuluphala ngokweqile kuhlotshaniswa nomdlavuza wendlala yesinye kanye nemiphumela emibi kakhulu. Gcina isisindo esinempilo, ikakhulukazi okhalweni.

items.title: Uma uneminyaka engu-50 noma ngaphezulu (40+ ngengozi ephezulu)
items.description: Bhuka ukuhlolwa kwe-prostate kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni. Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kwe-PSA kanye nokuhlolwa. Mahhala. Ukuphinda konyaka. Thatha umngane uma kukusiza ukuthi uhambe.

items.title: Uma unezimpawu zomchamo - zihlole
items.description: 'Ungalindi'. Izimbangela eziningi ziyelapheka, okuhlanganisa nomdlavuza uma ubanjwe kusenesikhathi. Ukuvakasha emtholampilo kukunikeza izimpendulo, hhayi ukuqagela.

items.title: Uma i-PSA iphakanyisiwe
items.description: Ungathuki - izimbangela eziningi aziwona umdlavuza (ukutheleleka, i-BPH, ngisho nokuhamba ngebhayisikili kwakamuva). Udokotela wakho uzohlela ukuhlolwa okwengeziwe uma kudingeka.

items.title: Uma uxilongwa - fika ethimbeni labahlinzayo
items.description: Izikhungo ezinkulu zomdlavuza ezibhedlela zinamathimba angochwepheshe be-urology. I-CANSA isiza ukuzulazula. Ziningi izindlela zokwelapha ezikhona - okuhlanganisa nokulinda umdlavuza okhula kancane.

items.title: Tshela amadodana akho nabafowenu
items.description: Umdlavuza wendlala yesinye unengxenye yofuzo. Uma unayo, izihlobo zesilisa kufanele zihlole ngaphambi kwesikhathi - ngokuvamile eminyakeni eyi-10 ngaphambi kweminyaka yakho yokuxilongwa.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwe-prostate kumahhala emitholampilo kahulumeni nasezibhedlela. Okunzima kakhulu ukuqala ingxoxo. Uma usukwenzile, isistimu inakekela okunye.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Ukuhlolwa kwe-PSA kwamahhala kanye nokuhlolwa kwe-prostate kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo

helplines.name: Ucingo losizo lwe-CANSA
helplines.description: Ulwazi lomdlavuza, amaqembu okusekela, ukuzulazula kokwelashwa
